title: Output Contest Matches
statement: Given a power-of-two number n, construct the tournament bracket string by pairing the first and last teams in each round until one match remains.
explanation: Represent teams as strings and repeatedly pair the first remaining team with the last, preserving bracket order.

title: Number of Provinces
statement: Given an n by n adjacency matrix for an undirected graph, return the number of connected components (provinces).
explanation: Start a graph traversal from each unvisited city; each new traversal discovers one province.

title: Student Attendance Record I
approach: Count absences and scan late streaks
statement: Return true if a student's attendance string contains fewer than two A characters and never contains three consecutive L characters.
explanation: Count absences and reject any string with a three-character LLL window.

title: Optimal Division
approach: Group all divisors after the first number
statement: Insert division operators and parentheses into a positive integer array to maximize the result, preserving array order.
explanation: For at least three numbers, the maximum is the first number divided by the quotient of all remaining numbers; this is achieved by grouping the denominator.

title: Reverse Words in a String III
statement: Reverse the characters of each word in a sentence while preserving the word order and spaces.
explanation: Split on spaces, reverse each word, then join the words with the same separator.
example: s="Let's take LeetCode contest" -> "s'teL ekat edoCteeL tsetnoc"

title: Maximum Depth of N-ary Tree
statement: Return the maximum number of nodes along a path from the root to any leaf in an N-ary tree; an empty tree has depth zero.
explanation: The depth of a node is one plus the maximum depth among its children.
example: root with children [3,2,4] and node 3 having child 5 -> 3

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
statement: Count contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k.
explanation: For each running sum, add the number of earlier prefix sums equal to runningSum-k, then record the current sum.

title: Array Partition
statement: Pair 2n integers into n pairs to maximize the sum of the smaller value in each pair.
explanation: After sorting, pair adjacent values; the smaller member of each pair is at every even index.

title: Binary Tree Tilt
statement: The tilt of a node is the absolute difference between the sums of its left and right subtrees. Return the sum of all node tilts.
explanation: Postorder DFS computes each subtree sum and accumulates the tilt at each node.

title: Reshape the Matrix
approach: Map flattened indices to new coordinates
statement: Reshape a matrix into r rows and c columns without changing the row-major order of elements. If the element count does not match, return the original matrix.
explanation: Map flat index i to old coordinates i/oldColumns and i%oldColumns, and to new coordinates i/c and i%c.
